drhp.business: Kusumgar makes over 1,000 SKUs of high-performance engineered fabrics based on polyamide/polyester filaments and polyurethane chemistry, and has expanded into finished aerospace and military products such as parachute systems, stealth solutions and rapid-deployment systems. It serves four segments: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics, Aerospace and Defence Solutions, Industrial and Automotive Fabrics, and Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics, selling to Indian government and private integrators in India and via exports.
drhp.end_markets: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics (FY26 31.67% of contract revenue)|Aerospace and Defence Solutions (FY26 22.97%)|Industrial and Automotive Fabrics (FY26 24.43%)|Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics (FY26 18.57%)
drhp.expansion: Company operates six facilities in Gujarat plus one fabrication unit in Uttar Pradesh; it intends to expand its aerospace product lines (paragliders, sails, hot-air/helium balloons, aerostats), sell its own aerospace/defence systems globally, and build coating/lamination capability for inflatables. The Offer is a pure Offer for Sale, so no fresh capex is funded by the IPO.
drhp.mdna: Geopolitical developments and higher global defence spending driving demand|China+1 sourcing shift boosting Indian demand and exports|Lumpiness from single large orders (CFF parachute order in FY25 not repeated in FY26)|Working capital swings (trade receivables jumped in FY26); negative operating cash flow in FY25|US tariffs (~50% total on Indian goods from Aug 2025) a risk to exports

promises.item: Execute the remaining balance of a Rs 2,371.96 million Aerospace and Defence Solutions order in Fiscal 2027 (only 23.61% executed in FY26).
Expand aerospace product lines into paragliders, sails, hot-air and helium balloons, aerostats and similar products.
Sell its own aerospace and defence systems (parachutes, decoys, shelters, camouflage nets) in India and globally, scouting distribution partners.
Build sales teams and appoint representatives for Europe, Middle East and North American defence-fabric markets.
Grow Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics by working closely with global brands (e.g. Decathlon) and capturing China+1 supply-chain shift.
Expand tapes business into the medical industry with custom medical-tape solutions and build coating/lamination capability for inflatables.
Continue to prioritise high-gross-margin, high-entry-barrier products to sustain sector-leading EBITDA margins.

sk.overview: Engineered fabrics are a subset of technical textiles: advanced, custom-made textiles designed for functional performance (durability, moisture resistance, breathability, tensile strength) rather than aesthetics, made from synthetic fibres (polyester, polyamide/nylon, aramid, PTFE, polyurethane) and blends with coatings and laminations. They serve defence, aerospace, industrial, automotive, outdoor and lifestyle, sports, construction and medical applications. The industry is characterised by high technical entry barriers, long product-approval cycles and R&D/customisation-driven growth.
